indicator_metadata.sourceNote: Gross domestic product is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period. It can be measured in three different ways: using either the expenditure approach, the income approach, or the production approach. This indicator is expressed in current prices, meaning no adjustment has been made to account for price changes over time. This indicator is expressed in United States dollars.

Chicken changed from U.S.A to Brazil from September 2021.
Coffee (Arabica), Cotton, Kolkata tea, and Metal updated for February 2024.
Beef, replacement series from January 2024
Lamb, replacement series from January 2020
Some oilseed November prices have updated entries while December are World Bank estimates. Some oilseed series have been replaced.

Some oilseed February prices have updated entries while some March prices are World Bank estimates.
Several oilseed series have been updated for the period April-November 2025.
Peanut (Groundnut) series updated for the period November 2024-July 2025.
Tobacco series updated for the period July-October 2025.

February 2026: LNG (Japan) corrected for 2024 (year) and the October-December 2024 (quarterly).

July 2026: Tea updated for June 2026.
